title: NFTastic
tagline: Simple tool to pull some NFT Collection metrics across all Chains/Collections available from Covalent APIs
description: This tool is to be able to see trends of various NFT collections over time. This eventually could be able to be used by NFT enthusiasts and speculators.aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
how_its_made:
This project was built fully using python with the following libraries:

requests

json

streamlit

pandas



We used the following Covalent API Endpoints:



/v1/chains/

/v1/chains/nft_market/

/v1/chains/nft_market/collection/
